title: A new work order starts billed to the customer's saved default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B, with one asset, asset 1.
  • Start on the Work Orders page.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Work Order.
  2. Pick customer A.
  3. Pick asset 1.
  4. Save the new work order.
  5. Expand the Customer card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Work Order window opens.

Step 2:

  • Customer A is picked.

Step 3:

  • Asset 1 is picked.

Step 4:

  • The new work order opens.

Step 5:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page), story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R6: “A new work order or part sale starts billed to the customer's saved default, if any, else the customer itself.”
  • Key Decisions: “A saved default Bill To, one hop, applied at creation only. Set in New Customer and Edit Customer; applied silently when a work order or part sale is created and shown on its Customer card.”
  • Feature Overview, Core Bill To: “A customer can have a saved default Bill To. New work orders and part sales for that customer start billed to it.”
  • Goals: “A saved default bills every new work order and part sale for that customer to the payer, with no step per job.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
